title: TenantConfig
description: Per-tenant theme + brand configuration. Maps to the 3-axis white-label contract (color + gradient + logo).

applications.description: Application grouping for the outer nav rail (apps ≠ modules — a tenant has applications, each containing modules; see @fams/v5-kit's AppDefinition/V5AppShell). Omit for a tenant that hasn't opted in — the outer rail then falls back to one implicit app spanning every licensed module.

icon.description: Icon key resolved by the consuming app (e.g. demo/seams.tsx's APP_ICONS map).

hideSwitcher.description: Suppress the cross-app switcher row while this application is active (@fams/v5-kit AppDefinition.hideSwitcher) — for an app whose persona never navigates to another application. The app's own modules still render in the rail normally. Omit/default false.

railStart.description: Pinned entries rendered ABOVE the application icons in the outer nav rail, framed by dividers (@fams/ui-kit SideNav `preItems` / @fams/v5-kit `TenantRuntimeConfig.railStart`). Each pins one licensed module (e.g. a tenant-global inbox surface). Purely positional — meaning stays with the module.

id.description: Stable rail-item id — also the key an injectable rail-indicator source is queried with.

module.description: Licensed module id this pinned entry navigates to.

label.description: Tooltip/accessible label override; defaults to the module's nav label.

landingModule.description: Where the index route `/` LANDS. Omit (the default) and `/` renders the metadata-driven Home launch pad. Set to a licensed module id — or the literal "first", meaning the first entry of this tenant's ordered `modules` array — and `/` redirects to that module's route instead. Home keeps its route and its nav entry either way; an id matching no resolved module falls back to Home with a dev warning.

logo.description: Logo key resolved by the consuming app (e.g. demo/seams.tsx's BRAND_LOGOS map) into the outer rail's logo slot.

hideName.description: Suppress the tenant NAME label rendered beside the rail logo. Set for a tenant whose logo asset already contains its wordmark, where the adjacent text is a duplicate. Presentational and scoped to that slot only — the tenant name still titles the top bar fallback, the app switcher and the command palette.

poweredBy.description: Show the rail-footer "Powered By FAMS" attribution strip. Set for a white-label tenant whose own brand owns the rail; the first-party FAMS tenant leaves it unset.

login.description: Login-screen branding for the tenant-variable brand pane (@fams/v5-templates LoginPage). The pane's STRUCTURE is layout-fixed in the DS; this section supplies only the per-tenant content that fills it.

quote.description: Headline/quote rendered in the brand pane.

background.description: CSS background for the brand pane (brand hex or gradient). Omit to fall back to the tenant's primary token.

supportingText.description: Auth-pane supporting line under the Welcome heading (e.g. "Log in to FAMS for …").

logo.description: Real logo asset URL for the auth pane's fixed 148x48 logo slot (app-servable path, e.g. /branding/fams-login-logo.png). Omit to fall back to the tenant text wordmark.

mobileLogo.description: WHITE (on-brand) logo asset URL for the MOBILE login brand header — the top third of the screen below the lg breakpoint, where the logo sits directly on the tenant brand color and the dark auth-pane `logo` asset is unusable. Omit to fall back to a white text wordmark.

mobileHeading.description: Heading for the MOBILE login sheet only (e.g. "Login", "Login via Credentials"). Omit to keep the desktop heading at every width.

illustration.description: Flattened brand-pane artwork asset URL (bottom-anchored, cover-cropped), OR the literal "none" to opt out of imagery entirely (a plain brand-color/gradient pane, e.g. UCCP's Figma spec). Omit to fall back to the DS's generic token-styled illustration.

footer.description: Auth-pane footer. Omit to keep the DS default "visit our website" line.

kind.description: Only the "powered-by" variant is supported today: a centered "Powered by" label + logo/wordmark.

logoSrc.description: Brand logo/wordmark asset URL rendered next to the label.
